fields.options:
🧑‍💼 New Hire Form
  • The New Hire form renders from the Employee DocType — the record it creates IS the Employee, held at status = Pending until onboarding completes.
  • Use the Form Builder below to choose which Employee fields appear, in which tab and section, and which are mandatory. Every Employee field is available.
  • A field with no row in Configured Fields follows the Employee DocType exactly. Employee’s own mandatory fields always render — the record cannot be saved without them.
  • Nothing is mapped or copied: a value captured here is already on the person’s Employee record.

fields.description: The form used when no other profile matches the new hire's company / employment type.
fields.label: Is Default

fields.description: Optional. Restricts this form to one company. Blank = applies to every company.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Optional. Restricts this form to one employment type. Blank = applies to every type.
fields.label: Employment Type

fields.description: On (default) = render ONLY the fields listed below. Off = render every Employee field, minus any marked Hide — rarely what you want on a 405-field doctype.
fields.label: Show Only Configured Fields

fields.description: Off (default) = every configured field renders for all new hires. On = each field gets an Employment Type and the form renders only the fields matching the type the user picks.
fields.label: Configure Basis Employment Type

fields.description: The Onboarding Portal Form released to the candidate when onboarding is initiated for a new hire raised on this form.
fields.label: Onboarding Portal Form

fields.description: On = onboarding is initiated the moment the approval matrix clears the new hire, with no second click. Off (default) = it waits in the pending list for HR to press Initiate Onboarding.
fields.label: Initiate Onboarding on Approval
